messages:
Alex: Heads up — seeing a perf regression on the new FlashLite attention variant after the upstream FA change (commit abcdef1). p95 spikes when KV cache is enabled and we use autoselect kernel. Profiling attached below. :eyes:

Priya: Can you share the numbers and a repro? Is this affecting paging/fused fallback or the fused kernel itself?

Alex: Short repro and profiler snippet: I ran our synthetic bench on a dedicated dev node. Command:```./bench --model llama-13b --batch 8 --seq 2048 --kv=true --kernel=autoselect --runs 30``` Result: mean throughput 210 tok/s (prev ~310), p95 latency 420ms -> was 230ms. Flame snippet (top lines):
- FlashLite::attention_kernel_v2 -> hot (60%)
- KVCache::lookup -> 18%
- cudaMemcpy (small) -> 6%

Also noticed autoselect prefers flashlite_v2 over fused when seq>1024, which wasn't the case before abcdef1.

Jamal: I can repro locally with the exact command. Quick log:```[run 6] seq=2048 batch=8 kernel=flashlite_v2 throughput=205 tok/s p95=438ms``` Looks like kernel emits extra matmul for KV layout change.

Priya: Is vLLM or xFormers involved in the path? We had a vLLM patch r12 that changed KV packing offsets.

Alex: Yes — vLLM r12 and xformers 0.0.17 both landed small layout adjustments. FA commit abcdef1 touched the kernel dispatch table which combined with vLLM change makes the FlashLite kernel do a slow memcpy path for cached KV when batch>4.

Devon: CI-bot flagged this overnight on our perf gate: "ci-bot: perf-test/latency-nightly failed — 26% regression on llama-13b flashlite config". Link: https://ci.redwood/inv/7743 (internal)

Marta: Rolling canary to 10% on Dedicated and will watch p95 and error budget. If we see >15% latency regression we’ll auto-rollback. :rocket:

Priya: Short-term mitigations:
- Pin FA upstream to abcdef0 (previous) in our dependency matrix.
- Add env override to force fused kernel: `REDWOOD_FORCE_KERNEL=flash_fused_v1`
- Adjust autoselect heuristic to prefer fused when seq>1024 until upstream patch lands.

Alex: Workaround I tested:```export REDWOOD_FORCE_KERNEL=flash_fused_v1
./bench --model llama-13b --batch 8 --seq 2048 --kv=true --kernel=autoselect``` Throughput returns to ~315 tok/s, p95 ~225ms.

Jamal: I'll prepare a small perf test that exercises KV-heavy long context to add to nightly regression suite. Will include both flashed/paged/fused permutations and assert throughput delta <8%.

Devon: I'll open an issue upstream in FA with a minimal repro and link vLLM/xformers patches that interact. Draft title: "FlashLite: KV memcpy path triggered by dispatch change (regression with vLLM r12)".

Priya: Also add a unit test in our kernel-selection component that checks selection policy with mocked seq/batch/KV flags so autoselect doesn't flip unexpectedly.

Marta: Ops plan: canary -> monitor -> either keep config override or rollback FA pin depending on vendor timeline. If upstream gives a patch quick, prefer patch + revert pin.

Alex: Notes for the issue: include perf logs, minimal repro (small harness that toggles KV cache on/off), and perf artifacts (nvprof top 20). I'll attach the nvprof timeline and the small harness in the issue.

Jamal: Quick todos:
- [ ] Add perf CI test (me)
- [ ] Open FA upstream issue (Devon)
- [ ] Patch autoselect heuristic + add unit test (Priya)
- [ ] Canary and monitor (Marta)

Priya: Thanks. If anyone sees regressions in other models (mix of seq lengths), ping here.

Marta: Marking this thread for follow-up in tomorrow's runtime standup. :white_check_mark:

Devon: Created upstream issue https://github.com/flash-attn/flashlite/issues/271 — included repro and profiler.

Alex: Great, keep me posted.

ci-bot: Note: nightly-perf-2026-03-16: regression detected for flashlite config (diff +24% p95).

Jamal: Re-running canary bench after applying REDWOOD_FORCE_KERNEL on stage now.

Priya: Good catch — this could have impacted some customers using long contexts. Appreciate the quick triage. :thumbsup:
